lines: 1 Thau tho, kandih kathuic khou maansei zaat guay,
Ravguangc tuang guanghdic kathanc aniu kasiamh di kho;
’Niu lunghchamh kho, bauhmei, machunhmei nai kho,
Ringhmei Kaipouc kandih khou tatruan guang dat pw the,
Zauc lo, Kamei guang dat pw the;
Maansei lung khou ringhmei
maibwang latkaeng ?|7 hylou khang,
Katuang Bumaengc ngamv paan khou ?|7,
Heipui zuk khou thuakloumei taanv tii guang tangh khang.
2 Thau tho, ngammei, pumtan naimei nac thiule,
’Suanmei nunc ?|7 Ravguangc khou ’twnmei latzan huay e;
Swmmay nunc dam tiilou niina tiilou tio,
Agaamvmei nunc ?|7 kaniw dam asut mak kan diu;
’Suan liangmei khang aniu thouc nai,
Kaniw ta tiiduaklou khang ?|7 ’niu ngamv guay tiigut kho,
Lungning daihmei nyngswmei kiu
Bangh sw bammei nunc ta tiiduakloumei hei e.
3 Siimei ngamv sinmei nunc 7?| buybaeng sin e,
Aniu thu Nang ta pamc e,
biangpiumei nunc swna;
Karaengmei pwanzingh tancna ’liu bam sihni,
Lauthwan ramgai khou Nang tuang zianmei kros ta how e,
Tiigaymei riw gaancna bam e,
Theic dat lakmei machunc 7?|
Kabaansyam guay ?|7 lyan e,
Martair nunc kumc Nang lev tat re,
Maansei nac nunc guay Ravguangc nac sw ngam mak saanv.
Amen.
